items.label: Range Intelligent Computing IR activity record: 2026-002 (08-30-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Management (IR record): the domestic compute market will stay supply-tight

set.signal: Management (IR record): the domestic compute market will stay supply-tight in the short term, with overall unit prices and profitability better than a year earlier; prices and gross margins of newly signed compute orders on the market are trending up. The two main industry constraints are irrational compute-equipment pricing this year (purchase prices keep deviating from a reasonable range) and supply shortages across the whole chain: not only high-performance servers but storage, optical modules, switches and related raw materials. CFO Dong Lei said that because of irrational competition in compute-equipment supply in H1 2026 the company strategically reduced purchases and focused on building its supply chain.

items.reason: The record says prices and margins of newly signed compute orders are rising across the market, not specifically the company's own new orders; wording made faithful.
